sections.content: You know the present subjunctive after wishes, emotions and value judgments from A2 Unit 27. Opinions take the indicative when the speaker presents the idea as asserted (*creo que*, *pienso que*, *considero que*). A negative opinion (*no creo que*, *no pienso que*) takes the subjunctive, because the idea is rejected, not asserted.

items.spanish: Creo que estudiar en grupo es útil.
items.english: I think studying in a group is useful.

items.spanish: No creo que estudiar solo sea siempre mejor.
items.english: I don't think studying alone is always better.

items.spanish: No pienso que este método sea eficaz.
items.english: I don't think this method is effective.

sections.content: *Creo que* presents the idea that follows as asserted: indicative. *No creo que* and *no pienso que* take the subjunctive.
